notes: New setting: Connected Textures, in Video Settings > Quality (with Sodium on). Glass and stained glass - blocks and panes - join into one window with no lines between the blocks, and a row of bookshelves becomes one long shelf. Resource packs made for OptiFine's connected textures work too. Fancy also draws the little corner pieces; Fast leaves them out.
Resource packs made for Minecraft 1.21.9 and newer (like Patrix 26.1) load now - before, the game skipped them.

New skin: Enderman. Pick it in Edit Profile and you become a real enderman - the long-legged walk, glowing eyes, and a block held out in both hands the way endermen carry them. Friends playing 1.18.2 Shaders see you as an enderman too; other versions show you as Steve.
Fresh Animations: endermen's glowing eyes stay on their heads now instead of floating in front of them.
Enderman skin: a block you hold now sits in the middle, between both hands, the way a real enderman carries it - it was off to one side by the left hand.
Clicking Controls in Options no longer crashes the game.
